label: Bog iron
lore: bog iron and steel with a rough copper alloy edge, worked by few smiths after the Duskfall (material-culture.md:52-57); Skyrim's iron and steel read as it

label: Bone and horn
lore: bone and horn worked with bronze tools; Naga-Kur weapons of their own dead; Xit-Xaht bone plate (material-culture.md:59-77)

label: Bone plate
lore: Xit-Xaht bone plate armour, "as effective as steel scale" (material-culture.md:79-82); Bone Cultist Armor relabelled

label: Bonemold
lore: Dunmer make only: holdouts, slavers' leftovers, the Dunmer minority (argonia-4e201-state.md:430); the lead's call 2 (issue #89)

label: Pre-Duskfall bronze
lore: pre-Duskfall bronze war gear and emblems (material-culture.md:52-54); Ancient Argonian Armor

label: Caravan steel (Khajiit and Bosmer traders' make)
lore: Khajiit coasters and Bosmer pilots trade along the coasts and rivers (foreign-powers.md, regions.json peoples); their guards' curved steel and padded mail

label: Chitin
lore: chitin is an attested Argonian working material (material-culture.md:59) and Morrowind's make; traded both ways over the border

label: Copper-edged steel
lore: steel with a rough copper alloy edge (material-culture.md:56-57): the Saxhleel metal set and BM&V's Argonian sword

label: Corsair's steel
lore: pirates and smugglers arm themselves from the ships they take (foreign-powers.md:107-118): cutlasses, rapiers and corsairs' knives

label: Crossbow work (bog iron and wood)
lore: the crossbow is a foreign weapon in the marsh: Imperial posts, Dunmer holdouts, pirates and Company marines carry it (foreign-powers.md); Dawnguard's crossbow and bolts, whose order's armour stays on the never list

label: Daedric
lore: Daedric gear enters only by story

label: Dragon bone and scale
lore: dragon gear enters only by story

label: Dwarven
lore: no Dwemer canon in the marsh: Dwarven gear has no road into Black Marsh (issue #89)

label: Ebony
lore: ebony is no Black Marsh make (material-culture.md:52-60): only a ruin's hoard holds it

label: Ayleid elven
lore: the Barsaebic Ayleid layer (ecology-encounters-loot.md:151)

label: Falmer
lore: decision 0006: Skyrim's own peoples' gear

label: Flint and jadeflint
lore: jadeflint and obverdian edges set in wood (material-culture.md:55-56)

label: Forsworn
lore: decision 0006: Skyrim's own peoples' gear

label: Skyrim glass
lore: malachite glass is no Black Marsh make (material-culture.md:52-60): only a ruin's hoard holds it

label: Greenwood (Bosmer make)
lore: Bosmer pilots and seafarers of the Topal coast keep their own bone, bark and hide gear and their bows (regions.json peoples)

label: Hide and fibre
lore: raw hide, lizard-skin wraps and woven grass and fibre (material-culture.md:69-70)

label: Hist amber
lore: Hist sap and, rarely, Hist amber: ritual, medicine and the province's most valuable contraband (ecology-encounters-loot.md:117-135); the Creation Club amber set relabelled

label: Imperial issue
lore: the Imperial layer is penal, fiscal and military only, a civic legacy at Gideon alone (ecology-encounters-loot.md:154)

label: Kothringi relic
lore: the Kothringi died of the Knahaten Flu in 2E 560; their scimitars, cleavers and shields lie in their towns

label: Marsh leather
lore: wamasu hide hardened or made flexible, crocodile and hackwing leather (material-culture.md:57-58; ecology-encounters-loot.md:121-124); Skyrim's own leather shared as it is

label: Masu plate
lore: plate over hardened wamasu hide (material-culture.md:57): the Reel-ka and Masu plate cuirasses, the heaviest Argonian make

label: Moonstone and Temple glass (Dunmer fine work)
lore: the Dunmer houses' and the Temple's fine arms, carried by house knights and armigers among the holdouts (foreign-powers.md, House Dres)

label: Netch leather and Ashlander make
lore: Morrowind's netch leather, Ashlander and raider light gear: the Dunmer minority and holdouts (argonia-4e201-state.md:430; Journey to Baan Malur)

label: Nordic and Skaal
lore: decision 0006: no Nordic element reaches the player

label: Volcanic glass
lore: pre-Duskfall smiths' volcanic glass, the blade set in bronze (material-culture.md:52-54); HTBM's Xanmeer weapons and Cuauhtli armour

label: Orcish
lore: no Orsimer in Black Marsh in 4E 201: Orcish gear has no road in (issue #89)

label: Saxhleel bone-and-leather work
lore: the Saxhleel's own bone blades and hardened wamasu leather (material-culture.md:56-58; King of the Murkmire's Saxhleel set): a finer make than raw bone and hide

label: Argonian scale
lore: giant-snake hide as Shadowfen armour and scale sewn on leather (ecology-encounters-loot.md:124); BM&V's Argonian guard armour and the Naga elite's scale

label: Shadowscale make
lore: the Shadowscales' own armour and blades (story/design/quests/reward-gear.md)

label: Turtle shell
lore: turtle and haj mota shell for shield bosses and whole shields; the Shellbacks' armour (ecology-encounters-loot.md:125)

label: Skyrim's orders
lore: decision 0006: the Dawnguard, the Blades, Penitus Oculatus, the Thieves Guild

label: Wood and bamboo
lore: tamarack wood and bamboo: clubs, staves, bows and spear shafts (story/lore/topics/material-culture.md:55-57)

label: Xanmeer relic
lore: the pre-Duskfall Argonian ruin layer: volcanic glass, bronze, gold (ecology-encounters-loot.md:145-150); HTBM's Xanmeer and Ocelotl sets
